Semaphore Flag Reference

Full A–Z flag semaphore alphabet reference with every two-arm position drawn on canvas. Searchable by letter or NATO phonetic name.

Positions are shown from the observer's point of view (as you see the signaler facing you). Arm angles: 0° = up, clockwise.

📖 How to use

  1. Browse the full A–Z chart, or
  2. type a letter or phonetic name to filter.
  3. Study each arm position on the drawn figure.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are the signals shown?

Each letter is shown as a signaler figure with two arms held at the correct clock positions, plus the position names in text.

Can I search the chart?

Yes — type a letter or a NATO phonetic name (like 'alpha' or 'tango') in the search box to filter the chart.

How does flag semaphore work?

Semaphore sends letters one at a time with two hand-held flags; positions follow a circle system of eight arm directions.
